capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: deguboard runs git in the workspace repository. Because a repository's git configuration (such as core.fsmonitor) can run arbitrary commands, deguboard does not work in untrusted folders (Restricted Mode).
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces.descripti: deguboard uses the local file system and git commands, so it does not work in virtual workspaces.
